description: MABEL STEWART LUDLUM [a.k.a.: "Sister Mabel"; Mrs. Seymour DeWitt Ludlum] Correspondence from Maria Chabot to Mabel Ludlum: Five letters and five postcards, Dec. 20, 1937 - Sept. 24, [1944]. Chabot's letter of Sept. 24, [1944] is a response to Ludlum's letter of Sept. 17, 1944. There is a photocopy of Chabot's letter of Dec. 1941 to Ludlum in this binder. Correspondence from Mabel Ludlum to Maria Chabot: Six letters and one envelope without contents, Oct. 28, 1933 - Sept. 17, 1944. The envelope without contents has, however, a recipe on the front and a pencil note on the back. There is a photocopy of Ludlum's letter of Jan. 6, 1941 in this binder.
title: Maria Chabot to Mabel Ludlum
